source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: At the close of your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase) and at the close of the [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), check whether any enemy unit was destroyed by the bearer’s unit during that phase. If so, test its [Leadership](vsdata:core-rule/leadership-rolls). Gain 1 CP if it passes.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.

condition.destroyedEnemyUnits: one or more in that phase
